subject: Kestrel close cadence + remediation options for slipping go-live
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel - immediate risk log update + go-live remediation

Team —

Quick heads-up: Kestrel (KD-4432) flagged by AE this morning — procurement has pushed their internal approval into the Oct 5 finance review, which puts our scheduled Sep 30 go-live at risk. Emily copied me and asked for an updated MAP and a clear mitigation we can sign up to this week.

I attached an initial risk log and a draft MAP (provisional_map_v1) — please treat as working documents. Need two pieces by EOD Monday (2028-09-17):

- Updated risk register with owner and likelihood/impact (use the attached template)
- Two remediation options we can offer to the customer (one that preserves the original scope and one staged rollout with reduced initial scope + credit)

If we can get these into a single doc and a short email thread to Emily today/tomorrow, we can avoid a formal exec escalation. LAURA: can you coordinate procurement / legal's asks? KARTHIK: can you quantify the perf/cost tradeoffs for the staged rollout option (approx token cost + infra window)?

Attachments: risk_log_q3.xlsx (stub), provisional_map_v1.pdf (stub)

Thanks — Sergio

Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0186

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kestrel - immediate risk log update + go-live remediation

Thanks Sergio — on it. Quick notes:

- I reviewed the original MAP and procurement redline log; Kestrel's primary blocker is the Q4 pricing hold (finance head wants a one-time liability moved to next FY).
- Legal flagged a short list of audit evidence items procurement will require; I'll pull what we can produce immediately and call out items needing more time.
- Proposed customer-facing options (draft):
  1) Option Alpha (preserve scope): delay go-live by 4 weeks, hold current pricing, provide a 30% partial implementation support credit for any delay-caused labor.
  2) Option Beta (staggered rollout): commit to core inference endpoints first (chat + embeddings for 2 teams), defer advanced routing and analytics for +8 weeks. Include a 10% credit on the deferred portion.

I'll update the risk_log with owners and likelihoods (initial pass) and prepare a single-page comparison table for Emily. Karthik, please add the cost delta numbers into "Option Beta" row.

I'll aim to send the consolidated MAP + risk log to Sergio by EOD Monday.

Laura Bennett
Senior Director, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@kestrelhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kestrel Procurement <procurement@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Sep 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kestrel - immediate risk log update + go-live remediation

Sergio / Laura / Karthik — thanks for the proactive outreach. Brief context from our side:

- Finance deferred the September approval because our head of Finance wants all vendor liabilities in Q3 closed against the Q4 budget review. That puts our internal sign-off timeline to the week of Oct 2–6.
- Procurement is not objecting to product terms but needs the MAP and a clear remediation commitment (pricing or phased delivery) documented for our director-level review on Sep 27.

Two asks from Kestrel:
1) Can you share a redlined MAP that lists the staged rollout elements and any credits/SLAs tied to late go-live?
2) A short risk log (1 page) that calls out the top 3 risks and what Redwood will do to mitigate/cure them with owners and SLA response times.

If you can get that to me no later than Tue (Sep 18) we can include the materials with the Sep 27 director packet. Otherwise procurement will push formal negotiation timelines into October and we will likely need to re-baseline.

Emily Chen
CTO, Kestrel Health
emily.chen@kestrelhealth.com

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@kestrelhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kestrel Procurement <procurement@kestrelhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Sep 2028 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel - proposed remediation options and updated MAP (v2)

Emily — thanks for the clarity and the timeline. Attached: provisional_map_v2.pdf (customer-facing MAP), risk_log_q3.xlsx (updated with owners), and a one-page options summary. High-level:

Option A — Preserve scope (Delay):
- Move go-live to Oct 28. Redwood will hold current pricing; provide a one-time implementation credit equal to 30% of the professional services line for any delay attributable to Kestrel procurement/finance.
- Redwood will commit to a 48-hour priority response SLA for any showstopper issues during the delayed window.
- Estimated cost delta to Redwood: minor; we absorb the implementation scheduling overhead.

Option B — Staggered rollout (Preferred):
- Go-live Sep 30 for core inference endpoints (chat + embeddings for 2 pilot teams). Defer analytics + advanced routing for 8 weeks (Nov 25 target).
- Redwood provides a 10% credit on the deferred scope and a targeted onboarding package to speed the phased rollout.
- The risk_log (attached) lists gating items; owners are assigned. Karthik has flagged the infra delta: an estimated incremental token cost of $2.3k/month for the pilot footprint (approx).

Request: please confirm which option your team prefers by close of business Sep 20, so we can lock resource schedules and avoid a recruiting/engineer hold. If we don't have a decision by Sep 20 we will need to re-baseline the timeline to the Oct–Nov window for capacity planning.

Attachments: provisional_map_v2.pdf (stub), risk_log_q3.xlsx (stub), map_summary_annotated.docx (stub)

Thanks — Sergio

Sergio Alvarez
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0186

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Kestrel decision capture + next steps (internal)

Sergio / Laura — brief internal capture after Emily's Friday reply and our Option notes. Emily indicated a strong lean toward Option B (staggered rollout) during the director sync, pending formal sign-off from procurement. Next internal actions: 

1) Exec approval request: please route the MAP v2 + one-pager to Anand (VP Sales) and Maria (Head of Legal) with the note below. I can draft a short approval email.
2) Resource lock: engineering should tentatively reserve the pilot capacity for Sep 30–Oct 30; we'll confirm once Emily signs.
3) Billing: finance needs the credit ticket created so procurement can see net terms; request a billing note for the 10% deferment credit.

I'll prepare the approval email and update the HubSpot deal with the new expected close (target Nov 25 for full scope).

Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
